findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mold to be present at mop sink caulking. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure facility is monitoring caulking at a frequency that prevents mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands. 

An employee was observed to don gloves and begin food handling without washing their hands. Education conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to ensure education trickles down to all staff moving forward. Ensure that employees wash their hands at all times that it is required while preparing foods.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

Encrusted residue is observed on the cut bar of the rack used for distributing the paper used for wrapping sandwiches. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean it and maintain it clean to protect the food contact surfaces moving forward. The item was cleaned during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

During this inspection a storm came through the area and water began leaking from the air ducts in the customer seating area. Repair prior to the next routine inspection. Maintain the facility in a state of good repair at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The multiple nozzles on the fountain drink machine are observed soiled during this inspection. The nozzles were disassembled and cleaned (wash/rinse/sanitize) during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

The prep cooler next to where orders are taken is consistently holding foods between 48F-52F. TCS items in this cooler were removed/discarded and the cooler was placed on time control until repairs can be completed. The same gentleman that will repair this cooler is already coming to this facility for another matter this evening and can work on it tonight per the owner. The inspector’s card was given and contact requested with an update when known. The current follow up will be Monday.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris. 

1) There is a crack in the caulking between the wall and hand sink as you walk into the back hallway. The PIC is instructed to repair prior to the next routine inspection. 2) The magnetic rack used for storing knives above the three part sink has bare wood observed. Reseal prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

During this inspection multiple food handler cards are observed expired. Other current employees do not appear to have food handler training completed. Ensure that food handler training is completed for all employees that handle food or food contact items. The PIC looked up courses during this inspection with the inspector present.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The sink and the sani buckets in the facility are observed at either low concentrations or a concentration of 0 during this inspection. The buckets and sink were remade during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

The mop is observed stored with the head pooled up in the bottom of the mop sink. The PIC was consulted and re-positioned the mop to correct the violation.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employee observed to wash hands then turn faucet off without using a barrier to prevent recontaminating hands. CORRECTED- Provided education and reviewed proper handwashing.
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Nozzles on the soda fountain observed to have build-up inside. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC, who cleaned nozzles. Discussed getting them on a cleaning schedule to maintain clean to sight and touch.
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Pizza sauce hot held on the flat top observed at 120F (probed). CORRECTED- Sauce reheated. Discussed hot holding temperatures and strategies to hold temperature (keeping a lid on when not in use, stirring to distribute heat). 
3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above. [P]
